component.name: Nyaa Paper
component.summary: Run Steam Workshop wallpapers on your desktop

description.p: Nyaa Paper is a front end for Wallpaper Engine's Steam Workshop wallpapers on Linux. Browse your subscriptions, tune each wallpaper's settings, give every monitor its own wallpaper and build playlists. Wallpapers keep running after the window is closed.

ul.li: A different wallpaper on every monitor, each with its own settings and GPU
Settings are remembered per monitor and per wallpaper
Playlists per monitor, in order or shuffled, with a set interval
Scene, video and web wallpapers, with sound, mouse interaction and presets
A keyboard-first library with animated previews and themes

description.p: Wallpaper Engine must be bought and installed through Steam: Nyaa Paper reads its files from your Steam folder and does not include them. Wallpapers are rendered by a bundled fork of linux-wallpaperengine.

screenshot.caption: A wallpaper's settings, applied per monitor
Engine options: audio, frame rate, scaling and GPU

description.p: Rewrite of the JavaFX app as a native daemon and Qt client, shipped as a Flatpak.

ul.li: Wallpapers keep running when the window is closed
Settings remembered per monitor and per wallpaper
Presets, user images and animated GIFs in wallpaper settings
Web wallpapers with sound, and fixed audio crackling in scenes
Title screen, themes and a keyboard-first library
